title: Contract from a computation segment
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with entry state $e$ and a designated set of exit states, and fix an input and an index type $I$. Suppose a precondition, running time, endpoint configuration, and lower and upper work-head bounds are specified for each index and starting configuration. If, whenever the starting configuration is in state $e$ and satisfies the precondition, the computation segment of the specified duration reaches the specified endpoint, avoids the exit set at all earlier times, and keeps every work-tape head between its specified bounds throughout the segment, and the endpoint state belongs to the exit set, then these data define a contract with those preconditions, times, endpoints, and bounds.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
An exit set of optional states
Precondition, time, endpoint, and lower and upper bound functions
A segment property for every indexed start in the entry state satisfying the precondition
Endpoint membership in the exit set for every such start
